programs.description: The wildlife of the Maasai Mara reveals the raw beauty and realities of one of the most untamed lands, highlighting the daily struggle for survival and the balance between predator and prey.

From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

The filmmaker showcases the biological ingenuity of desert animals that helps them survive in the Namib, one of the harshest places on Earth.

programs.description: The breach of a massive great white in New Zealand triggers an expedition to find Colossus, a mythical shark thought to reveal a secret great white colony.
